justification: Both show profile-view standing figures in shallow relief with raised arms and long patterned garments, and both fill the surrounding field with repeated ornamental signs or motifs, which is a fairly generic correspondence. The content differs sharply: A is a multi-figure scene of people flanking a laden offering stand with a register of script signs, while B is a single dominant composite bird-headed winged figure carrying a handled bucket between vertical bands of rosette-and-scroll foliage.
